mentions.name: Organizational Assessment App
mentions.description: This app helps companies assess their organization, understand strengths and weaknesses through assessments, and identify areas for improvement.
mentions.problem: Companies need a clear way to understand their organizational strengths and weaknesses and identify areas for improvement.
mentions.audience: Businesses and companies seeking to understand their organizational strengths and weaknesses.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m currently developing an organizational assessment app for businesses.
The app is designed to help companies understand their organizational strengths and weaknesses through assessments and identify areas for improvement.
